name: Megalithic Temples of Malta
description: Scattered across Malta and its sister island Gozo, seven stone temples were raised between about 3600 and 2500 BC, making them some of the oldest free-standing buildings in the world. Ġgantija on Gozo is named for its giant boulders, while Ħaġar Qim, Mnajdra and Tarxien show how skilfully early islanders shaped curved, chambered stone halls with very limited resources.
